newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Average rate on Swedish 7-day T-bill 4.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: Average rate on Swedish 7-day T-bill 4.78 pct.

text.p: The average rate on a seven-day treasury bill was 4.78 percent, Sweden's National Debt Office said on Tuesday.

The weighted average rate was 4.779 percent while the lowest rate was 4.760 percent and the highest accepted rate was 4.783 percent, the office said. The office said all the bids were served at the highest rate. -- Abigail Schmelz, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1003
